question: Does repeatedly reintroducing the deepest decoder context reduce lesion undercoverage beyond a capacity-matched ordinary local residual fusion?

arms.local_fusion: Residual fusion reads current decoder feature and skip at each 16/32/64 stage
arms.anchor_fusion: Identical residual fusion instead reads the first 8x8 Swin output resized directly to each stage, plus the same skip

routing_factor: local_fusion and anchor_fusion have identical parameters, initialization and operators; only context source differs

module.residual_output: zero initialization; initial outputs exactly baseline
module.placement: after normal upsample+skip sum, before each of 3 Swin levels

not_claimed: proof that coarse features are always correct
absence of global context in original Swin
full reproduction of EMCAD or MVSeg
prior_evidence: stage25 some recurring severe interior undercoverage, not universal large-lesion degradation
stage26 coarse probes recover some failures but inferior overall
stage27 auxiliary loss alone did not reliably transfer coverage benefits

training.encoder: only levels2/3 trainable; all modules eval, no DropPath

selection: maximum validation per-image mean foreground Dice, earliest exact tie; never test-based
metrics: common evaluation.py macro and pooled Dice/IoU/precision/recall, Prec@ thresholds, threshold Jaccard, boundary F1, HD95; per-image records; severe recall<.5

analysis.primary: anchor vs local_fusion; both vs control
analysis.secondary: GT-area quartiles, severe undercoverage, new >5pp failures, FP/FN pixel tradeoff, validation-only branch interventions
analysis.seed_confirmation_trigger: validation macro Dice at least +0.20 percentage points above both controls, severe undercoverage no higher than control, pooled Dice no more than 0.10pp lower; trigger is practical screening, not statistical significance
analysis.test: all 3 fixed validation-best weights evaluated only after training and exact validation replay; regardless of favorable results; no follow-up decision from test

hardware: RTX A4000 16GB; same calibrated microbatch all arms; gradient accumulation maintains 64; validation and test batch64
cache: only immutable prefix f1/f2/mid and current augmented targets; trainable f3/f4 recomputed every optimizer step
completion: training_done does not mean experiment complete; pipeline must finish validation and test for all arms
limitations: One seed, one screened split, already-exposed test. No publication or novelty guarantee.
